title: movement.json as the shared tuning contract (loaders, schema, CI sync)
summary: Make config/movement.json the single source of truth in practice: a JSON Schema, a Unity copy kept byte-identical by CI, and a Python loader in services/traversal that exposes the same constants plus the 85 % margin helper the validator will use.

acceptance_tests.test: config/movement.schema.json (JSON Schema 2020-12) validates config/movement.json; every key in Bible §10 is required; additionalProperties is false.
unity/Assets/StreamingAssets/movement.json is byte-identical to config/movement.json; a documented copy step exists (script or editor menu) and CI movement-sync passes.

services/traversal/movement.py loads the file into typed dataclasses, exposes `with_margin(value)` = 0.85 × value, and raises on missing or unknown keys (pytest coverage of load, margin, and error cases is suggested).
A test asserts the C# and Python loaders agree on every constant (shared fixture of expected values).
services/traversal/requirements.txt pins exact versions; pip-audit clean.

history.event: AUTH #003 applied: acceptance-criterion levels added; iOS-only wording
